gloss: to give up on; to abandon; to see through

definitions.gloss: to give up on; to abandon; to write off
definitions.explanation: To conclude that something or someone is hopeless and decide to stop investing effort, money, or attention.

definitions.gloss: to see through; to judge fully; to size up
definitions.explanation: To assess something or someone completely and reach a decisive conclusion about their true nature or value.

examples.japanese: あの{店|みせ}を{見切|みき}った。
examples.english: I gave up on that store.

examples.japanese: {在庫|ざいこ}を{見切|みき}って{安|やす}く{売|う}ることにした。
examples.english: We decided to write off the inventory and sell it cheaply.

examples.japanese: {将来性|しょうらいせい}がないと{見切|みき}って、{会社|かいしゃ}を{辞|や}めた。
examples.english: Having concluded there was no future in it, I quit the company.

examples.japanese: {相手|あいて}の{実力|じつりょく}を{見切|みき}る。
examples.english: To size up the opponent's ability.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{一瞬|いっしゅん}で{敵|てき}の{動|うご}きを{見切|みき}った。
examples.english: He read the enemy's movements in an instant.

examples.japanese: {市場|しじょう}の{動向|どうこう}を{的確|てきかく}に{見切|みき}るのは{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: It's difficult to accurately gauge market trends.

notes:
A compound verb from {見|み}る (to see) + {切|き}る (to cut/complete). The {切|き}る ending adds the nuance of doing something decisively or completely — here, seeing something through to a final conclusion.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})
- No standard intransitive pair
- Pattern: XがYを{見切|みき}る

ASPECT (ている):
- Type: Telic (has endpoint)
- {見切|みき}っている = has given up on / has already judged

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {見切|みき}りをつける: to give up on; to cut one's losses (closely related set phrase)
- {在庫|ざいこ}を{見切|みき}る: to write off inventory
- {見切|みき}り{品|ひん}: clearance items; marked-down goods
- {見切|みき}り{発車|はっしゃ}: jumping the gun; starting before things are ready

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {諦|あきら}める: to give up — focuses on emotional resignation; {見切|みき}る implies a more rational, decisive judgment
- {見極|みきわ}める: to ascertain; to discern — focuses on carefully determining the truth; less decisive than {見切|みき}る
- {見限|みかぎ}る: to give up on; to abandon — very close synonym to sense 1, with a slightly stronger nuance of disgust or disappointment

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {見切|みき}っていませんでした
